versions.summary: First version: date separation, objectives and roles, incumbents and method comparisons, search budgets and stopping, verification, resources, governance and the adoption preflight (change log §8).

Minor: report-only tail severity (p95, worst-10% mean DD), candidate consideration kept apart from qualification, participation attribution by stage, and an [S] item on protected investigation of multi-component participation (change log §8). No mandatory rule changed; studies pinned to 1.0.0 keep their pin.

Major: §7.7 [M] reporting format — written analysis, Markdown tables and machine-readable results only; no charts, plots, SVGs, screenshots, images, dashboards, HTML visual reports or PDFs (the user's preference, Priority 5A brief §1). Earlier visuals preserved; studies pinned to 1.0.0 or 1.1.0 keep their pin. No research-method rule changed (change log §8).

Minor: §3.5 [S] convention changes (A frozen incumbent, B direct conversion, C re-optimized selection, with the decomposition) and §4.8 [S] reproducing a registered reference method (pin, stage map, omitted-stage reassignment, proportional scaling, budget equivalence); the companion docs/research/methods/ with NL0 1.0.0 (change log §8). No [M] rule changed; studies pinned to earlier versions keep their pin.

Minor: §1.8 [S] the consequence of the chronological verdict, precommitted before searching (default: no chronological support, not a deployment-qualified candidate without an explicit user decision; an informed lane's selection has no independent chronological test), and §5.9 [R] chronological exposure disclosure (open-lot share of training net, largest open lot's market-value multiple and give-back, per-lot MAE, D1 hold-window tail stress on a declared reference history, training neighbourhood on the next slice), report-only with no threshold (change log §8). No [M] rule changed; studies pinned to earlier versions keep their pin.

Major: §9 [M] GPU-only official optimization and CPU/GPU parity — official evaluations only on the attested NVIDIA GPU evaluator with no CPU fallback (fail closed), the single official gate with live preflight and attestation, reachable-domain capability coverage, device receipts and the conservation invariant, permanent bit-identical parity for every evaluation-dependency change (TypeScript authoritative, CUDA C++ the accelerator), stale-port protection, explicit non-official CPU purposes, activation only by an ACCEPTED acceptance record, the merge gate and entrypoint audit, evaluationBackend in the adoption manifest and the no-evasion rule (GPU Phase 2 brief; change log §8). Studies pinned to earlier versions keep their pins; official GPU optimization stays blocked until config/gpu-backend/acceptance.json is ACCEPTED.

Major: explicit, fixed research date ranges (config/research/date-ranges.json; R1 development 2016-01-04 → 2024-12-31, validation 2025-01-01 → 2026-10-30) instead of an endpoint defined by the files' coverage (§0.3, §1.3 rewritten: windows fixed before research inside a pinned range, with byte-prefix data provenance); new [M] §1.12 appended data never move a window (enforced at data access; a later range only as a new user-authorized entry), §1.13 manual evaluation on newer data is not research evidence, §1.14 reproducible inputs after appends (prefix verification, never weaker checks). The user's brief of 2026-11-27 (change log §8). Studies pinned to earlier versions keep their pins; every manifest's windows are checked against the range.

Major: evidence categories (§0.3: formal historical research, manual post-validation evaluation, controlled prospective (shadow) evaluation, live trading performance); §1.13 clarified (manual post-validation evaluation is informational, records its dates, execution convention and data provenance, never silently influences historical research, and is not prospective by itself); new [M] §1.15 controlled prospective (shadow) evaluation (configuration sealed before the first observed session opens, pre-registered method/observation start/acceptance criteria, verifiable provenance, causal and complete, versioned changes, reported apart from historical validation, no retroactive classification) and §1.16 categories never interchanged (shadow is not live); scope `prospective` with its preflight checks. The user's Assignment 1 brief of 2026-11-27 §8 (change log §8). Studies pinned to earlier versions keep their pins; N/original's November 2026 evaluation stays a manual post-validation evaluation.
